community.note: Global S1 PvE build (2026-10-03, opinion, Kaeria TW video 2026-09-28). In-game macro lines: Earth Punishment > Condemnation > Chain of Torment (bottom slot wins), Divine Aura > Debilitating Mark > Light of Regeneration > Judgment Thunder, Lightning Strike Scattershot only on stagger. Prayer, Noble Aura and charged Bolt are pressed by hand; heals and Light of Regeneration omitted (not damage). Light of Protection is a toggle, modeled as a passive.

Inven Cleric guide 2026-09-24 via research/tmp/classes.json (opinion, KR): opener buffs, then Earth Punishment > Chain of Torment > Condemnation from the macro, hold Earth's Retribution, Scattershot on stagger; Bolt and heals by hand; Debilitating Mark only when the party is hurting (left out). Prayer first is from the same page's skill sheet ("biggest self buff") and the Kaeria opener.

Safe-window DPS order "buff/debuff > Bolt > Divine Aura > filler" (opinion, KR/TW patch history, retrieved 2026-10-03). The page names no filler, Judgment Thunder and Earth's Retribution are assumed. It does not mention Condemnation or Earth Punishment.
Leveling packs (2026-10-03, opinion): Chain of Torment (hits up to 4) > Condemnation > Divine Aura with the AoE specialization > Judgment Thunder; Earth's Retribution weaved for mana.
